Thanks for looping me in 	6 reviewed the pcap. High level proposed test plan:

Summary:
- Replay factor: run at 1.5x observed peak QPS to include headroom (so target ~1,800 QPS sustained, 2,700 QPS peak during spike window)
- Duration: 2 hours (30m warm-up, 1h steady, 30m cool-down)
- Endpoints: inference endpoints + auth; we'll throttle downstream if non-inference endpoints are noisy

Dedicated sizing recommendation (preliminary):
- Recommend Dedicated pool sized to ~4 x 80GB-A100 equivalent for the run (we can provision vGPU-backed instances if you prefer)
- If you prefer hosted burst, expect higher variability and we will run with conservative parallelism; results will be less deterministic for dedicated-cost modeling

Pre-test checklist / dependencies:
- Provide S3 url or upload pcap to our secure bucket (we can pull with a pre-signed link)
- Provide a test API key and 5 seed accounts (we will not use production keys)
- Confirm IP ranges to be whitelisted (we will provide IP list)
- Provide expected error handling behavior for auth failures/429s

I've attached a short test plan PDF (redwood_test_plan.pdf) and a checklist. Once we have the signed-off S3 link + test keys we'll provision capacity and run a dry-run the day before.

Estimate timeline: provision + dry-run within 48 hours of receiving artifacts; full run on agreed window.

Let me know if you want a lower-cost profile (we can run with fewer GPUs and longer ramp-up) 	6 we can model cost vs. latency tradeoffs in the MAP.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
